name: How do I choose the right replacement hardware for my windows?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right replacement hardware for my windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right replacement hardware involves considering your window's brand, type (e.g., double-hung, casement), and the specific part that needs replacement. Matching the style, finish, and functionality to your existing windows is also important for aesthetics and performance. For older windows, finding exact matches can be challenging, but many universal or compatible aftermarket parts are available. Consulting with a professional can help you identify the correct specifications and explore suitable options that meet both your needs and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose hardware by considering your window's brand, type, and the specific part needed. A professional can help identify correct specifications and options.
